title: next-sweep hand-overs: 13 checklist rows left partial or not driven in the v18.4.0 sweep
body:
triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Source: v18.4.0 sweep close-out, #32908 comment 6881136418 (devx#4 ledger, read at `87330e89`), routed by triage.

Rows that the v18.4.0 sweep left partial or didn't drive. The next `checklist-test` run picks them up.

## Partial: blocked on a dependency or ledger marker (8)
- 1: `access-security.rls-both-sides` acceptance[5]: D11 spot-check, blocked(dependency, #7463).
- 2: `access-security.crud-permission-matrix` acceptance[5]: guest_portal, blocked(dependency, #23267).
- 3: `integration-system.datasource-credential-refusal-matrix` acceptance[0]: the build door and the connector inline-auth door were not driven.
- 4: `records-forms.crud-roundtrip` acceptance[6]: the clone-readonly half is blocked(fixture): no lead_score plant.
- 6: 11 items blocked by their ledger markers: multi-replica ×6, Oracle ×2, SQL Server, AI chat Cloud/EE, locale-scoped seed.
- 8: `identity-auth.auth-method-matrix`: the SSO and device variants are blocked(environment). Splitting the drivable rows from the blocked ones would let a run score.
- 9: `studio-authoring.expression-editors` [0][1][3][5][6]: only the retest rows were re-driven.
- 10: `ux-conventions.disabled-control-reason`: only the three #32102 rows were re-driven.

## Needs a live drive (3)
- 7: `integration-system.email-template-render` acceptance[7]: the no-provider 501 arm was read from `email-routes.ts` only.
- 106: `automation.package-flow-override`: removing a node through the Studio canvas was not driven.
- 114: `platform-core.bare-name-one-holder-refusal` acceptance[2]: resolution of qa_a's `auth.password_reset` through the email service was not driven.

## Coverage gaps: a new clause or item (2), the seat decides
- 196: `api-backend.package-rest-lifecycle`: no clause says 'the manifest served after a restart equals the last one written' (card-B-api-4).
- 232: no item asserts #33075's SCIM-deactivation key revocation live: a revoked key answers 403 `API_KEY_REVOKED`.

## Do
Drive the partial and live rows in the next sweep, and split row 8 when the item's text is next touched. For 196 and 232, author the clause or item with `checklist-author`. That's the seat's call, not the maintainer's.

## Grade
**p2**.

## Reader
`domain:devx`.
